questions.question: Two wrist watches were sold for Rs. 1,980 each. One wrist watch was sold at a profit of 10% and the other one at a loss of 10%, The entire transaction resulted in:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The selling price of each wristwatch = Rs. 1980

**Concept used:**

CP = SP × 100/(100 – Loss%)

CP = SP × 100/(100 + Profit%)

**Calculation:**

CP of 1 watch = 1980 × 10/11

⇒ Rs. 1800

CP of another watch = 1980 × 10/9

⇒ Rs. 2200

Total CP = 1800 + 2200

⇒ Rs. 4000

Total SP = 1980 × 2

⇒ 3960

Loss = 4000 – 3960

⇒ Rs. 40

**∴ The entire transaction resulted in a loss of Rs. 40.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**When Profit and loss % are the same and SP is also the same then it will give only a loss

+ 10% -10% + (-10 × 10)/100

⇒ -1%

Loss = 3960 × 1/99

⇒ Rs. 40

**∴ The entire transaction resulted in a loss of Rs. 40.**

questions.question: A solid metallic cube of side 4.4 cm is melted and recast in the form of a wire of radius 2 mm. Find the length (in cm) of the wire. (use π = 22/7)
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Length of the edge, a = 4.4 cm

Radius = 2 mm = 0.2 cm

**Concept used:**

Volume of cube = a³

Volume of cylinder = πr²h

**Calculation:**

Volume of the cube = (4.4)³

⇒ 85.184 cm3 

Now, Volume of the wire = πr²h

22/7 × 0.2²

⇒ 0.88/7

We know that, Volume of the cube = volume of the wire 

So, Length of the wire = a³/πr²h

⇒ (85.184 × 7)/0.88 

⇒ 596.288/0.88

⇒ 677.6

**∴ The length of the wire is 677.6 cm**

questions.question: If 21 tan θ = 20, then(1 + sin θ - cos θ) : (1 - sin θ + cos θ) is equal to:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

21 tan θ = 20

**Concept used:**

tanθ = P/B

sinθ = P/H

cosθ = B/H

P = perpendicular

B = base

H= hypotenuse

**Calculation:**

We know 20, 21 and, 29 is a Pythagorean triplets

So, 21 tan θ = 20

⇒ tanθ = 20/21

⇒ sinθ = 20/29

⇒ cosθ = 21/29

(1 + sin θ - cos θ) : (1 - sin θ + cos θ)

⇒ (1 + 20/29 - 21/29) : (1 - 20/29 + 21/29)

⇒ (29 + 20 - 21)/29 : (29 - 20 + 21)/29

⇒ 28 : 30

⇒ 14 : 15

**∴ Required value is 14 : 15**

questions.question: If x² + y² = 45 and x - y = 5 then what is the value of x³ - y³?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

x2 + y2 = 45

x - y = 5

**Formula used:**

(a - b)² = a² + b² - 2ab

a3 - b3 = (a - b)(a2 + b2 + ab)

**Calculation:**

x - y = 5

⇒ (x - y)² = 25

⇒ x2 + y2 – 2xy = 25

⇒ 45 – 2xy = 25

⇒ 2xy = 20

⇒ xy = 10

x3 - y3 = (x - y)(x² + y² + xy)

⇒ 5{45 + 10}

⇒ 5 × 55

⇒ 275

**∴ Required answer is 275**

questions.question: If a person travels at a speed of 48 km/h, he will reach his destination on time. He covers two-thirds of his journey in five-sixths of time. At what speed (in km/h) should he travel to cover the remaining distance to reach his destination on time?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Normal speed of the person = 48 km/h

**Concept used:**

Speed = Distance/Time

**Calculation:**

Let he usually travels for 6x hours

So. his total distance = 48 × 6x

⇒ 288x km

According to the question,

He covered 288x × 2/3 = 192x km in 5x hours

So remaining 288x - 192x = 96x km

He will cover it in x hours

So, speed = 96x/x = 96 km/h

**∴ He should travel 96 km/h to cover the remaining distance to reach his destination on time.**

questions.question: The ratio of the ages of A and B, four years ago, was 4 ∶ 5. Eight years hence, the ratio of the ages of A and B will be 11 ∶ 13. What is the ratio of their present ages?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Ratio 4 years ago = 4 : 5 (difference 1 unit); Ratio 8 years hence = 11 : 13 (difference 2 units).

Equate differences by multiplying the first ratio by 2: (4 × 2) : (5 × 2) = 8 : 10.

Growth of 3 units (11 − 8 or 13 − 10) corresponds to a total gap of 12 years (4 + 8).

3 units = 12 years ⇒ 1 unit = 4 years.

Present ages: A = (8 × 4) + 4 = 36; B = (10 × 4) + 4 = 44. Ratio = 36 : 44 = 9 : 11.

**∴ The correct answer is 9 : 11.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Ratio of ages of **A and B** four years ago = 4 : 5 and eight years hence = 11 : 13.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/878d44830f77b33a7cd6b6bbd7aa2be3b952dc9a321953e8e47cd55735682d5d.png] 

Let the ages of **A and B** four years ago be 4x and 5x respectively.

⇒ Present age of A = 4x + 4

⇒ Present age of B = 5x + 4

⇒ Ages after 8 years: A = 4x + 12, B = 5x + 12

⇒ (4x + 12) / (5x + 12) = 11 / 13

⇒ 13(4x + 12) = 11(5x + 12)

⇒ 52x + 156 = 55x + 132

⇒ 3x = 24 ⇒ x = 8

⇒ Present age of A = 4(8) + 4 = 36 years

⇒ Present age of B = 5(8) + 4 = 44 years

⇒ Required Ratio = 36 : 44 = 9 : 11

**∴ The correct answer is 9 : 11.**

**__Additional Information__**

Constant Age Difference

The mathematical difference between the **ages** of two individuals always remains constant throughout their lives, regardless of the time elapsed.

Ratio Balancing Method

When two ratios at different time intervals are given, multiply the terms such that the **difference** between the ratio parts remains the same as the actual years passed.

Time Gap Logic

The total **time gap** between 'n' years ago and 'm' years hence is calculated as (n + m) years.</p

questions.question: If a³ + b³ + c³ - 3abc = 250 and a + b + c = 10, then what will be the value of (1)/(5)(ab+bc+ca)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

a3 + b3 + c3 - 3abc = 250

a + b + c = 10

**Formula used:**

x3 + y3 + z3 - 3xyz = (x + y + z){x2 + y2 + z2 - (xy + yz + xz)}

(x + y + z)² = x2 + y2 + z2 + 2(xy + yz + xz)

**Calculation:**

a3 + b3 + c3 - 3abc = 250

⇒ (a + b + c){a² + b² + c² - (ab + bc + ca)} = 250

⇒ {a2 + b2 + c2 - (ab + bc + ca)} = 25 ----(i)

a + b + c = 10

⇒ (a + b + c)² = 100

⇒ a2 + b2 + c2 + 2ab + 2bc + 2ca = 100 ----(ii)

By doing (ii) – (i) we get

3ab + 3bc + 3ca = 75

⇒ ab + bc + ca = 25

(1)/(5)(ab+bc+ca)

⇒ 1/5 × 25

⇒ 5

**∴ The value of (1)/(5)(ab+bc+ca) will be 5**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__**Put a = 5, b = 5 c = 0

a3 + b3 + c3 - 3abc = 125 + 125 + 0

⇒ 250

a + b + c = 5 + 5 + 0

⇒ 10

Both are satisfying

So, (1)/(5)(ab+bc+ca) = 1/5(25 + 0 + 0)

⇒ 5

∴ The value of (1)/(5)(ab+bc+ca) will be 5

questions.question: A, B and C can independently complete the same task in 4, 6 and 12 days, respectively. In how many days will they be able to complete the same task if they work together?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A can do in 4 days

B can do in 6 days

C can do in 12 days

**Concept used:**

One day work of x = 1/b

Here b = time to taken to complete the work

**Calculation:**

A's one day work = 1/4

B's one day work = 1/6

C's one day work = 1/12

A + B + C one work = 1/4 + 1/6 + 1/12

⇒ (3 + 2 + 1)/12

⇒ 6/12

⇒ 1/2

⇒ Time = 2 days

**∴ They will complete in 2 days**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/50d66d9af2ea66379b13407eec72381a596919510246b399d9ae79f9d5c1ebd7.png] 

Total efficiency = 6

So, work will be complete in 12/6 = 2 days

∴ They will complete in 2 days

questions.question: If 5k = tan θ and (5)/(k)=sec theta, then what is the value of 10(k²-(1)/(k²))?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

5k = tan θ

(5)/(k)=sec θ

**Concept used:**

sec2θ – tan2θ = 1

**Calculation:**

5k = tan θ

⇒ k = tan θ/5

⇒ k² = tan² θ/25

(5)/(k)=sec θ

⇒ 1/k = sec θ/5

⇒ 1/k² = sec² θ/25

10(k²-(1)/(k²))

⇒ 10(tan2 θ/25 – sec2 θ/25)

⇒ 10{(tan2 θ/25 – sec2 θ)/25

⇒ 10(-1/25)

⇒ -(2)/(5)

**∴ The value of 10(k²-(1)/(k²)) is -(2)/(5)**

questions.question: The lengths of three sides of a triangle are in the ratio 3 ∶ 4 ∶ 5. Among three sides, the difference between the largest side and the smallest side of this triangle is 3.6 cm. The area (in cm?) of the triangle is:

⇒ 19.44 cm²
